text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—The "Mile Championship." True to its 
name, formidable rivals have gathered.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't feel like I'll lose. If I 
perform at my best, I can win.

Yes, Oguri Cap should be able to win this. 
Taking this victory will solidify both her 
ability and popularity. And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will stand at the pinnacle of the mile. 
Keep your eyes on me!
